name: Purchase approval routing

parameters.content:
## Purchase approval routing
Request → policy → auto-approve, return, or approver form (Wait node) → audit log.

**Policy:** budget code must be valid · restricted spend → finance · over $5,000 → director · over $500, new supplier or a likely split purchase → manager · nobody approves their own request.

**AI:** reads the description only (category, restricted?, summary). **AI off:** keyword categories.

nodes.name: Load sample data
nodes.notes: Invented, labelled items served by the mock services

nodes.name: Apply spending policy
nodes.notes: Policy rules decide; AI only categorises

nodes.name: AI switched on?
nodes.notes: Off: the rule-based path handles everything

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sample_id: $json.sample_id, request_id: $json.request_id, event: 'routed', route: $json.route, approver: $json.approver, category: $json.category, categorised_by: $json.categorised_by, rules: $json.rules, amount_nzd: $json.amount_nzd, actor: 'policy' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.route === 'auto_approve' ? 'Approved: ' + $('Apply spending policy').item.json.request_id + ' ($' + $('Apply spending policy').item.json.amount_nzd + ' from ' + $('Apply spending policy').item.json.supplier + ') is within policy. Go ahead and order.' : 'Returned: ' + $('Apply spending policy').item.json.request_id + ' needs a valid budget code before it can be approved.' }) }}

nodes.name: One request at a time
nodes.notes: Each approval waits for its own form

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sample_id: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.sample_id, request_id: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.request_id, requester: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.requester, amount_nzd: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.amount_nzd, supplier: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.supplier, category: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.category, route: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.route, approver: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.approver, summary: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.approver_summary, rules: $('Apply spending policy').item.json.rules, form_url: $execution.resumeFormUrl }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.approver + ', please review ' + $json.request_id + ': ' + $json.summary + ' Policy: ' + $json.rules.join('; ') + '. Decide here: ' + $execution.resumeFormUrl }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ sample_id: $json.sample_id, request_id: $json.request_id, event: 'decision', route: $json.route, decision: $json.decision, approver: $json.approver, actor: $json.answered_by, comment: $json.comment, rules: $json.rules }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ decision: $('Record decision').item.json.decision, answered_by: $('Record decision').item.json.answered_by, comment: $('Record decision').item.json.comment }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $('Record decision').item.json.request_id + ' was ' + $('Record decision').item.json.decision + ' by ' + $('Record decision').item.json.answered_by + ($('Record decision').item.json.comment ? ': ' + $('Record decision').item.json.comment : '.') }) }}

description: Routes purchase requests with a fixed spending policy: auto-approves small, in-policy spend, returns requests without a valid budget code, and sends the rest to the right approver through a form. Every step is written to an audit log.
